title: The Hobbit
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
synopsis: A comfort-loving hobbit is talked into joining thirteen dwarves on a journey to reclaim their mountain home from a dragon, and finds more courage and cunning in himself than anyone expected.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
synopsis: A young hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to carry it toward the one place it can be destroyed.

title: A Wizard of Earthsea
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
synopsis: A gifted boy studying magic on an island archipelago unleashes a shadow in a moment of pride and must pursue it across the sea to learn its true name.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
synopsis: An innkeeper with a hidden past recounts his years as a brilliant, penniless student of magic and his search for the beings who murdered his family.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
author: C. S. Lewis
synopsis: Four evacuated siblings discover a snowbound country through the back of a wardrobe and are drawn into its long struggle against a witch who has banished spring.

title: The Colour of Magic
author: Terry Pratchett
synopsis: An incompetent wizard is ordered to guide the Discworld's first tourist, whose sentient luggage and boundless optimism attract disaster wherever they go.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
synopsis: In a world where ash falls from the sky and a god-emperor has ruled for a thousand years, a street thief learns she can burn metals for power and joins a crew planning the impossible.

title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
author: Susanna Clarke
synopsis: Two very different magicians revive English magic during the Napoleonic wars, and their rivalry draws the attention of a fairy with plans of his own.

title: The Fifth Season
author: N. K. Jemisin
synopsis: On a continent wracked by apocalyptic seasons, a woman with the power to still earthquakes searches for her kidnapped daughter as the world ends once more.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J. K. Rowling
synopsis: An orphan raised in a cupboard learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, and begins his first year at a school where a hidden stone is being guarded.

title: Northern Lights
author: Philip Pullman
synopsis: A wild girl and her shape-shifting daemon travel to the Arctic to rescue kidnapped children and stumble onto experiments that reach into other worlds.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
synopsis: A noble family takes charge of the only planet that produces the most valuable substance in the universe, and its young heir must survive betrayal in the deep desert.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
synopsis: A burnt-out hacker is given back his ability to enter cyberspace in exchange for one last run against an artificial intelligence with its own agenda.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
synopsis: A mathematician who can predict the fall of a galactic empire establishes a colony of scholars at the edge of space to shorten the dark age that follows.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
synopsis: An envoy from a league of worlds tries to win over a planet of people who have no fixed sex, and learns how much of his own thinking depends on that difference.

title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
author: George Orwell
synopsis: A clerk who rewrites history for a totalitarian state begins a forbidden love affair and a private rebellion that the state has already anticipated.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
synopsis: In a future engineered for contentment, where people are grown in bottles and soothed by drugs, a man raised outside the system is brought in as a curiosity.

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
synopsis: A fireman whose job is to burn books meets a neighbour who asks whether he is happy, and starts to hide the very things he is paid to destroy.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
synopsis: A brilliant child is taken to an orbital school and pushed through increasingly brutal war games meant to prepare him to command a fleet against an alien enemy.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
synopsis: Seconds before Earth is demolished to make way for a bypass, an ordinary Englishman is whisked into space by a friend who turns out to be an alien travel writer.

title: The Three-Body Problem
author: Liu Cixin
synopsis: A physicist's disillusionment during a violent political era leads her to answer a signal from the stars, with consequences that surface decades later in a strange video game.

title: Kindred
author: Octavia E. Butler
synopsis: A Black writer in 1970s California is pulled again and again back to a Maryland plantation before the Civil War, where her survival is tied to a slaveholder's son.

title: Solaris
author: Stanisław Lem
synopsis: A psychologist arrives at a station orbiting a sentient ocean and is confronted by a visitor who looks exactly like the woman he once failed.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
synopsis: A young scientist assembles a living being from dead matter, then abandons it, and is pursued by the articulate, lonely creature he refused to care for.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
synopsis: In a theocratic republic that has replaced the United States, a woman assigned to bear children for a commander records her narrow, watchful days.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
synopsis: A family legend of a spectral hound seems to have claimed another baronet on the moor, and Sherlock Holmes sends Watson ahead to watch the heir.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
synopsis: A train stuck in a snowdrift, a passenger stabbed in his locked compartment, and a carriage full of strangers who all have something to hide from Hercule Poirot.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
synopsis: Ten strangers lured to an island are accused by a recorded voice of crimes they got away with, then begin to die one by one in the order of a nursery rhyme.

title: The Big Sleep
author: Raymond Chandler
synopsis: Private detective Philip Marlowe is hired by a dying millionaire over a blackmail note and walks into a tangle of gambling, pornography and murder in Los Angeles.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
synopsis: On the morning of their fifth anniversary a wife vanishes, and her husband's evasions, her diary and the media make it hard to know whom to believe.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
synopsis: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant, damaged hacker investigate the decades-old disappearance of a girl from a wealthy Swedish industrial family.

title: The Name of the Rose
author: Umberto Eco
synopsis: A Franciscan friar and his novice investigate a series of deaths in a medieval abbey whose labyrinthine library holds a book someone will kill to hide.

title: The Day of the Jackal
author: Frederick Forsyth
synopsis: A professional assassin hired to kill the French president builds his plan detail by detail, while a modest detective races to identify a man with no name.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
author: Thomas Harris
synopsis: A trainee FBI agent is sent to interview an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist in the hope that he will help catch a killer who skins his victims.

title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
author: John le Carré
synopsis: A retired intelligence officer is quietly brought back to find the Soviet mole at the top of the British secret service, one of four men he used to call colleagues.

title: Rebecca
author: Daphne du Maurier
synopsis: A shy young bride arrives at her husband's grand estate and finds it still ruled by the memory of his glamorous first wife and the housekeeper who adored her.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
synopsis: The second of five daughters in a family with no fortune trades barbs with a proud, wealthy newcomer and slowly revises everything she was sure of about him.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
synopsis: A plain, fiercely independent governess falls in love with her brooding employer, whose house hides a secret laughing in the attic.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
synopsis: A foundling raised on a Yorkshire farm and the daughter of the house form a bond so consuming that its bitterness poisons the next generation.

title: Persuasion
author: Jane Austen
synopsis: Eight years after being talked out of an engagement to a penniless naval officer, a quiet woman meets him again, now a wealthy captain who seems to have forgotten her.

title: Outlander
author: Diana Gabaldon
synopsis: A nurse on a post-war holiday in Scotland steps through a circle of standing stones into 1743 and must marry a young Highlander to stay alive.

title: Wolf Hall
author: Hilary Mantel
synopsis: A blacksmith's son rises to become Henry VIII's indispensable minister, steering the king's break with Rome while remembering everyone who ever underestimated him.

title: All the Light We Cannot See
author: Anthony Doerr
synopsis: A blind French girl and a gifted German orphan drafted into the army follow separate paths that converge in a walled Breton town during the last days of the war.

title: The Book Thief
author: Markus Zusak
synopsis: Narrated by Death, the story of a foster girl in wartime Germany who steals books, learns to read, and shares them with a Jewish man hidden in the basement.

title: War and Peace
author: Leo Tolstoy
synopsis: Five aristocratic families live through Napoleon's invasion of Russia, and a searching young count tries to work out how anyone should live.

title: Beloved
author: Toni Morrison
synopsis: A formerly enslaved woman living in Ohio after the Civil War is visited by a young stranger who may be the daughter she lost eighteen years before.

title: The Remains of the Day
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
synopsis: An ageing butler takes a motoring trip through the English countryside and reflects on a lifetime of loyalty to an employer who did not deserve it.

title: Things Fall Apart
author: Chinua Achebe
synopsis: A proud Igbo wrestler and farmer sees his village's traditions, and his own place in them, undone by the arrival of missionaries and colonial officials.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
synopsis: Seven generations of the Buendía family found, rule and lose the town of Macondo, where miracles are ordinary and a prophecy waits in a gypsy's manuscripts.

title: The Kite Runner
author: Khaled Hosseini
synopsis: A privileged boy in Kabul betrays his loyal friend and, decades later as an exile in America, returns to a ruined country to make amends.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
synopsis: Through the eyes of a young girl in a Depression-era Alabama town, a lawyer's defence of a Black man falsely accused of assault exposes the town's quiet cruelties.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
synopsis: A bond salesman on Long Island becomes the confidant of a mysterious millionaire whose lavish parties are all in service of winning back a woman he lost.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
synopsis: A destitute former student convinces himself that an extraordinary man may kill a worthless pawnbroker, then discovers what the act does to him.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J. D. Salinger
synopsis: Expelled from another prep school, a sixteen-year-old drifts around New York for a few days, judging everyone as a phony and looking for someone to talk to.

title: The Grapes of Wrath
author: John Steinbeck
synopsis: Driven from their Oklahoma farm by dust and debt, the Joad family drives west to California and finds the promised work is a trap.

title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
synopsis: A father and his young son push a shopping cart south through the ash of a dead world, keeping their fire alive and avoiding those who have stopped being human.

title: Norwegian Wood
author: Haruki Murakami
synopsis: Hearing an old song on a plane, a man remembers his student years in Tokyo, a fragile girl he loved after his best friend's death, and the lively girl who pulled him toward life.

title: Half of a Yellow Sun
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
synopsis: A houseboy, a professor's lover and an English writer live through the birth and collapse of Biafra during the Nigerian civil war.

title: Americanah
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
synopsis: A Nigerian woman builds a life and a sharp-eyed blog about race in America, then returns to Lagos and the man she left behind.

title: Slaughterhouse-Five
author: Kurt Vonnegut
synopsis: An optometrist who survived the firebombing of Dresden as a prisoner of war becomes unstuck in time and is exhibited in an alien zoo.

title: The Old Man and the Sea
author: Ernest Hemingway
synopsis: After eighty-four days without a catch, an old Cuban fisherman hooks a giant marlin far out in the Gulf Stream and fights it for days.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
synopsis: A sweeping account of how one species of ape came to dominate the planet through shared fictions such as money, nations and religions.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
synopsis: A physicist explains the big bang, black holes and the nature of time for readers with no equations, and asks whether the universe needs a creator.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
synopsis: A psychologist describes the two systems that drive our judgement, one fast and intuitive and one slow and deliberate, and the predictable errors of each.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
synopsis: A tour of the universe and the history of the people who tried to understand it, written with the conviction that science is a source of wonder.

title: Bad Blood
author: John Carreyrou
synopsis: The reporter who exposed Theranos tells how a charismatic founder built a nine-billion-dollar blood-testing company on technology that never worked.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
synopsis: The diary kept by a Jewish teenager during the two years her family hid in a concealed Amsterdam annexe before they were discovered.

title: Long Walk to Freedom
author: Nelson Mandela
synopsis: The autobiography of the man who led the struggle against apartheid, spent twenty-seven years in prison and became South Africa's first democratically elected president.

title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
author: Maya Angelou
synopsis: The first volume of the poet's memoirs, from a childhood in segregated Arkansas through trauma, silence and the discovery of her voice.

title: Leaves of Grass
author: Walt Whitman
synopsis: A collection the poet revised for the rest of his life, celebrating the body, democracy and the American landscape in long unrhymed lines.

title: The Waste Land
author: T. S. Eliot
synopsis: A long poem of fragments, voices and quotations that captured the exhaustion of Europe after the First World War.

title: The Prophet
author: Kahlil Gibran
synopsis: Before sailing home, a prophet answers the townspeople's questions on love, work, children, joy and death in poetic prose.

title: Ariel
author: Sylvia Plath
synopsis: The poems written in the last months of the poet's life, published after her death, fierce and precise about motherhood, rage and mortality.

title: Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair
author: Pablo Neruda
synopsis: The young Chilean poet's collection of sensual, melancholy love poems that made him famous at nineteen.

title: Paradise Lost
author: John Milton
synopsis: An epic in blank verse retelling the fall of Satan and the temptation of Adam and Eve, with the rebel angel as its most vivid character.

title: Beyond Good and Evil
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
synopsis: Aphorisms and essays attacking the dogmatism of past philosophers and sketching a morality beyond the categories of good and evil.

title: Sophie's World
author: Jostein Gaarder
synopsis: A Norwegian schoolgirl begins receiving letters that teach her the history of philosophy, while stranger letters suggest her own world is not what it seems.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
synopsis: A psychiatrist who survived Auschwitz describes what kept prisoners alive and outlines a therapy built on the human need for meaning.

title: Walden
author: Henry David Thoreau
synopsis: An account of two years spent living simply in a cabin by a Massachusetts pond, and an argument for deliberate living.

title: Charlotte's Web
author: E. B. White
synopsis: A runt pig saved by a farm girl is befriended by a clever barn spider who sets out to save him a second time by writing words in her web.

title: Matilda
author: Roald Dahl
synopsis: A small girl of enormous intelligence, neglected by her parents and terrorised by a headmistress who throws children, discovers she can move things with her mind.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
author: Roald Dahl
synopsis: A poor boy finds one of five golden tickets and tours a chocolate factory where the other winners are undone by their greed.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
author: Maurice Sendak
synopsis: Sent to bed without supper, a boy in a wolf suit sails to an island of monsters, becomes their king, and sails home to find his supper still hot.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh
author: A. A. Milne
synopsis: A bear of very little brain and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood hunt heffalumps, look for Eeyore's tail and visit Rabbit for lunch.

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
synopsis: An elderly brother and sister on Prince Edward Island send for a boy to help on the farm and receive a talkative red-haired orphan girl instead.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
synopsis: A girl follows a hurried white rabbit down a hole into a world of shrinking potions, mad tea parties and a queen fond of beheadings.

title: The Gruffalo
author: Julia Donaldson
synopsis: A mouse walking through the deep dark wood invents a terrible monster to scare off predators, then meets the monster itself.

title: The Lightning Thief
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: A dyslexic twelve-year-old discovers he is the son of a Greek god and must recover Zeus's stolen lightning bolt before the gods go to war.

title: Coraline
author: Neil Gaiman
synopsis: A bored girl finds a door to a mirror flat where her Other Mother, with buttons for eyes, offers her everything she wants in exchange for staying forever.

title: زقاق المدق
author: نجيب محفوظ
synopsis: في زقاق صغير بالقاهرة أثناء الحرب العالمية الثانية، تحلم فتاة جميلة بالخروج من الفقر، وتتشابك أقدار جيرانها بين الطموح والخيانة.

title: أولاد حارتنا
author: نجيب محفوظ
synopsis: حكاية حارة مصرية يتوارث أبناؤها الصراع على وقف الجد الغامض، في رواية رمزية عن العدل والقوة أثارت جدلاً واسعاً عند نشرها.

title: ثرثرة فوق النيل
author: نجيب محفوظ
synopsis: موظف حكومي يقضي لياليه في عوامة على النيل مع أصدقاء يهربون من الواقع بالكيف والكلام، حتى تقع حادثة تفرض عليهم مواجهة أنفسهم.

title: موسم الهجرة إلى الشمال
author: الطيب صالح
synopsis: يعود شاب سوداني من دراسته في لندن إلى قريته على النيل، فيلتقي رجلاً غامضاً عاش في إنجلترا وترك وراءه أثراً من العشق والدمار.

title: رجال في الشمس
author: غسان كنفاني
synopsis: ثلاثة فلسطينيين من أجيال مختلفة يحاولون عبور الصحراء إلى الكويت مختبئين في خزان شاحنة فارغ، بحثاً عن عمل وكرامة.

title: ذاكرة الجسد
author: أحلام مستغانمي
synopsis: رسام جزائري فقد ذراعه في حرب التحرير يكتب إلى ابنة قائده القديم التي أحبها في باريس، فتتداخل ذاكرة الوطن مع ذاكرة الحب.

title: عزازيل
author: يوسف زيدان
synopsis: راهب مصري في القرن الخامس الميلادي يدوّن اعترافاته على رقوق، بين الإسكندرية وأورشليم وأنطاكية، وصوت داخلي يدفعه إلى الشك.

title: عمارة يعقوبيان
author: علاء الأسواني
synopsis: سكان عمارة قديمة في وسط القاهرة، من أرستقراطي عجوز إلى شاب فقير يسكن سطحها، يكشفون معاً صورة مجتمع يتغير بقسوة.

title: ساق البامبو
author: سعود السنعوسي
synopsis: شاب من أب كويتي وأم فلبينية يعود إلى الكويت بحثاً عن هوية وعائلة، فيجد أنه غريب في البلدين معاً.

title: مدن الملح
author: عبد الرحمن منيف
synopsis: واحة هادئة في الصحراء تتحول رأساً على عقب حين يصل الأمريكيون بحثاً عن النفط، في الجزء الأول من خماسية عن تبدل الحياة في الجزيرة العربية.

title: الأيام
author: طه حسين
synopsis: سيرة ذاتية يرويها عميد الأدب العربي بضمير الغائب، عن طفولته في قرية بصعيد مصر بعد أن فقد بصره، ثم دراسته في الأزهر.

title: مقدمة ابن خلدون
author: ابن خلدون
synopsis: مدخل لتاريخ العالم يضع أسس علم العمران، ويشرح كيف تنشأ الدول على العصبية ثم تشيخ وتسقط.

title: L'Étranger
author: Albert Camus
synopsis: Un employé d'Alger apprend la mort de sa mère sans émotion apparente, tue un homme sur une plage et se retrouve jugé autant pour son indifférence que pour son crime.

title: La Peste
author: Albert Camus
synopsis: Les rats meurent dans les rues d'Oran, puis les hommes ; un médecin et quelques compagnons choisissent de lutter alors que la ville est fermée au monde.

title: Le Petit Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
synopsis: Un aviateur tombé dans le désert rencontre un petit garçon venu d'une autre planète, qui lui raconte sa rose, ses voyages et ce que les grandes personnes ne voient pas.

title: Les Misérables
author: Victor Hugo
synopsis: Un ancien forçat racheté par la bonté d'un évêque consacre sa vie à faire le bien, poursuivi sans relâche par un policier qui ne croit pas au changement.

title: Madame Bovary
author: Gustave Flaubert
synopsis: Mariée à un médecin de campagne médiocre, une jeune femme nourrie de romans cherche dans l'adultère et le luxe une vie à la hauteur de ses rêves.

title: Le Comte de Monte-Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
synopsis: Un jeune marin trahi et emprisonné quatorze ans s'évade, découvre un trésor et revient à Paris sous un nouveau nom pour se venger méthodiquement.

title: Candide
author: Voltaire
synopsis: Chassé du château où on lui enseignait que tout est pour le mieux, un jeune homme naïf traverse guerres, naufrages et tremblements de terre en testant cette idée.

title: Vingt mille lieues sous les mers
author: Jules Verne
synopsis: Un professeur, son domestique et un harponneur sont recueillis par le capitaine Nemo à bord d'un sous-marin qui parcourt les océans loin de toute loi humaine.

title: Bonjour tristesse
author: Françoise Sagan
synopsis: Pendant un été sur la Côte d'Azur, une adolescente manipule les amours de son père pour préserver leur vie insouciante, avec des conséquences qu'elle n'avait pas voulues.

title: Le Deuxième Sexe
author: Simone de Beauvoir
synopsis: Une analyse de la condition des femmes à travers la biologie, l'histoire, les mythes et l'expérience vécue, qui affirme qu'on ne naît pas femme, on le devient.

title: Germinal
author: Émile Zola
synopsis: Un ouvrier sans travail descend dans une mine du Nord et finit par mener une grève qui révèle la misère des mineurs et la violence de la Compagnie.

title: Mémoires d'Hadrien
author: Marguerite Yourcenar
synopsis: L'empereur romain vieillissant écrit à son successeur pour raconter sa vie, son pouvoir, son amour pour Antinoüs et sa manière d'accepter la mort.

title: Les Fleurs du mal
author: Charles Baudelaire
synopsis: Un recueil de poèmes sur la beauté, le spleen, la ville et la mort, condamné pour outrage aux bonnes mœurs lors de sa parution.

title: Piranesi
author: Susanna Clarke
synopsis: A gentle man lives alone in an endless house of halls and statues flooded by tides, keeping careful journals that slowly reveal how he came to be there.

title: Normal People
author: Sally Rooney
synopsis: A popular boy and an outsider girl from the same small Irish town drift in and out of each other's lives through school and university, never quite saying what they mean.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
synopsis: A woman raised by survivalists in the Idaho mountains, kept out of school and away from doctors, teaches herself enough to reach university and, eventually, Cambridge.

title: Born a Crime
author: Trevor Noah
synopsis: A comedian recounts growing up in South Africa as the son of a Black mother and a white father at a time when their relationship was illegal.

title: فرانكشتاين في بغداد
author: أحمد سعداوي
synopsis: بائع خردة في بغداد يجمع أشلاء ضحايا التفجيرات في جسد واحد، فيستيقظ الجسد ليطالب بالثأر لكل جزء فيه.

title: L'Élégance du hérisson
author: Muriel Barbery
synopsis: Une concierge parisienne qui cache sa culture et une fillette surdouée décidée à mourir se reconnaissent grâce à l'arrivée d'un locataire japonais.
